mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, available_balance AS availableBalance, lifetime_granted AS lifetimeGranted, lifetime_spent AS lifetimeSpent, lifetime_expired AS lifetimeExpired, version, status FROM reading_ticket_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, available_balance AS availableBalance, lifetime_granted AS lifetimeGranted, lifetime_spent AS lifetimeSpent, lifetime_expired AS lifetimeExpired, version, status FROM reading_ticket_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_ticket_ledger (entry_no, user_id, entry_type, amount, balance_after, business_type, business_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, operator_type, operator_id, reason, policy_version) VALUES (#{entry.entryNo}, #{entry.userId}, #{entry.entryType}, #{entry.amount}, #{entry.balanceAfter}, #{entry.businessType}, #{entry.businessId}, #{entry.idempotencyKey}, #{entry.requestHash}, #{entry.operatorType}, #{entry.operatorId}, #{entry.reason}, #{entry.policyVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT id, entry_no AS entryNo, user_id AS userId, entry_type AS entryType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, business_type AS businessType, business_id AS businessId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_hash AS requestHash, policy_version AS policyVersion FROM reading_ticket_ledger WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_ticket_lot (user_id, source_type, source_ref, granted_amount, remaining_amount, grant_ledger_id, effective_at, expire_at, status, policy_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{grantedAmount}, #{grantedAmount}, #{grantLedgerId}, #{effectiveAt}, #{expireAt}, 'ACTIVE', #{policyVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_ticket_account SET available_balance=available_balance+#{amount}, lifetime_granted=lifetime_granted+#{amount}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{accountId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, effective_at AS effectiveAt, expire_at AS expireAt, status, version FROM reading_ticket_lot WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND remaining_amount>0 AND effective_at<=#{at} AND expire_at>#{at} ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, effective_at AS effectiveAt, expire_at AS expireAt, status, version FROM reading_ticket_lot WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND remaining_amount>0 AND expire_at<=#{cutoff} ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_ticket_lot SET status=CASE WHEN remaining_amount=#{amount} THEN 'EXHAUSTED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, closed_at=CASE WHEN remaining_amount=#{amount} THEN #{at} ELSE NULL END, remaining_amount=remaining_amount-#{amount}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{lotId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_at<=#{at} AND expire_at>#{at} AND remaining_amount>=#{amount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_ticket_lot_allocation (ledger_id, lot_id, amount, lot_remaining_after) VALUES (#{ledgerId}, #{lotId}, #{amount}, #{remainingAfter})
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_ticket_account SET available_balance=available_balance-#{amount}, lifetime_spent=lifetime_spent+#{amount}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{accountId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND available_balance>=#{amount}

UPDATE reading_ticket_lot SET status='EXPIRED', closed_at=#{closedAt}, remaining_amount=0, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{lotId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND remaining_amount=#{expectedRemaining} AND expire_at<=#{closedAt}

UPDATE reading_ticket_account SET available_balance=available_balance-#{amount}, lifetime_expired=lifetime_expired+#{amount}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{accountId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND available_balance>=#{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, book_index_id AS bookIndexId, source_type AS sourceType, source_id AS sourceId, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_until AS validUntil, status, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, policy_version AS policyVersion FROM chapter_entitlement WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND book_index_id=#{bookIndexId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from<=#{at} AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until>#{at}) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, book_index_id AS bookIndexId, source_type AS sourceType, source_id AS sourceId, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_until AS validUntil, status, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, policy_version AS policyVersion FROM chapter_entitlement WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND book_index_id=#{bookIndexId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from<=#{at} AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until>#{at}) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter_entitlement (user_id, book_id, book_index_id, source_type, source_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, idempotency_key, policy_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{bookIndexId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, 'ACTIVE', #{idempotencyKey}, #{policyVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reading_ticket_ledger WHERE user_id=#{userId}

SELECT id, entry_no AS entryNo, user_id AS userId, entry_type AS entryType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, business_type AS businessType, business_id AS businessId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_hash AS requestHash, policy_version AS policyVersion FROM reading_ticket_ledger WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reading_ticket_lot WHERE user_id=#{userId}

SELECT l.id, l.user_id AS userId, l.source_type AS sourceType, l.source_ref AS sourceRef, g.entry_no AS grantEntryNo, l.granted_amount AS grantedAmount, l.remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, l.effective_at AS effectiveAt, l.expire_at AS expireAt, l.status FROM reading_ticket_lot l JOIN reading_ticket_ledger g ON g.id = l.grant_ledger_id WHERE l.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
